text: Find a missing space on disk: search by its id, or enter the new path by hand
description:
Felix 2026-11-24. Only spaces with a local path can go missing this way: checkouts (registry kind 'checkout') and the machine-local localPath of linked repos (.bowman/runtime). Created and remote spaces live in the server's spaces dir; if one vanishes that is a server bug, not something to search for.
- Detection: a checkout whose path no longer holds .bowman/meta.json shows as missing on the Spaces page (and in list_linked_repos as not-checked-out).
- Search: scan the home folder for .bowman/meta.json (skip node_modules, .git, caches) whose repoId matches; re-point the registry entry to the hit. Name matches are only offered as suggestions, never re-pointed automatically.
- Manual: a field to enter the new path directly; it is accepted when that folder's .bowman has the same id (or after confirming when it doesn't).
- Agents: an MCP tool doing the same (search, or take a path).
Build after the internal graph→space rename, with the new names.

status.comment: Accepted by Felix 2026-11-24; waits for the internal graph→space rename.
